g.text: Magnitude and total activity during the same stationary-cue experiment
Both quantities use physical amount, including Spring's changing circumference. Endpoint pairs are shown against sampled trajectory ranges.
Shading spans sampled minima and maxima over cue-on plus release; it is not uncertainty. Filled final points are distinct from cue-on activity growth.
Activity amount and first-moment magnitude are separate quantities: opposing regions can reduce the resultant without depleting total activity.
